title: tx-ring window semantics (expiry, W-boundary slot reuse, stale-slot reset) have zero direct tests
detail: The honest-util numerator's defining mechanics — 240-tick wraparound, stale-slot reset, expiry exclusion — are untested. A wraparound bug silently corrupts the metric this job exists to fix; T1 hashes and symmetric replay-check cannot catch it.
recommended_fix: Add bundles_test cases: record across >240 ticks and assert expired slots drop out; write tick T then T+240 (same slot) asserting no double-count; assert idle-gap ticks are excluded.

title: bundles_rebuild tx-ring zeroing never tested against a populated ring
detail: The comment's own failure mode — stale served history misattributed after topology edits reshape bundles — has no regression test. Dropping the zero pass (resize alone) passes every existing gate.
recommended_fix: Extend test_bundle_rebuilds_on_topology_change: record real served units, demolish/reshape a pipe to trigger bundles_rebuild, then assert bundle_tx_window returns 0 for every bundle.

title: noc_pipe_rows predicate change (carried>=cap → util_pct>=red_pct) lacks any discriminating test
detail: The measure/draw agreement is the scroll-clamp contract (the N9 test's purpose). The new threshold predicate and its disabled (red_pct<=0) path are unpinned; divergence between the two copies breaks scroll clamping silently.
recommended_fix: Extend noc_panel_rows_counts_the_section_caps: append pipe rows with util_pct 95/85/100; expect 2 counted pipe rows at red=90, 0 when red_pct<=0, matching draw-side membership.

title: Display changes (tray chips, node_health trace, queue-row util/rate block) have no automated pin
evidence:
harness/goldens.odin capture path renders only `rnd.draw_world(&rc.view, topo, bundles, flow, crisis, tick, {}, -1, -1, seed, interp_alpha)
	rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, preview)` — no tray/node_health/NOC. draw_tray/draw_node_health_card are called only from app/main.odin:1573/1584/2218. harness/overlay.odin: the overlay-check PNG is `bin/overlay-<demo>-<ms>.png` (gitignored — a verification artifact, never committed). Diff: `TRAY_CHIP_W :: 112` (was 96) + `load_bytes := u64(units) * u64(pp.FRAME_BYTES) / u64(max(1, cat.balance.packet_bandwidth))`.
detail: T2 pixel goldens structurally exclude HUD/NOC pixels, so the changed displays are covered only by the manual KYLE check. The pure label computations (noc_pipe_rate, node load_bytes) are unit-testable but untested.
recommended_fix: Pin the pure label math in render tests: noc_pipe_rate/noc_pipe_rate_compact outputs for the tier ladder and the node_health load_bytes conversion; leave pixels to KYLE per convention.

title: shadow_clone tx-ring deep-copy is invisible to unit tests (state_hash excludes derived state)
detail: Deleting the two clone_dyn lines passes all 239 render tests; the PR itself admits the missed clone was 'caught by the full harness run', i.e. E2E-only. No unit-level isolation pin exists.
recommended_fix: In spawn_fx_test: after shadow_clone, mutate clone.bundles.tx_served and assert the live ring is unchanged (deep-copy isolation pin).

title: units helpers' defensive returns and sub-Kbps/KiB formatter tiers unpinned
detail: New public surface's zero-argument guards and lowest formatter tiers (bare bps, KiB rounding edge) have no expectations. Trivial branches, but currently untestable-by-accident rather than by pin.
recommended_fix: Add pins: served_to_octets(_, 0)=0, util_pct_window(x,0,0)=0, format_rate(999)="999 bps", format_rate_compact(999)="999", format_bytes(1024)="1.0 KiB".

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Coverage evidence: P0 covered — units_test pins `testing.expect_value(t, util_pct_window(240 * 15, 240, 15), u32(100))` and `testing.expect_value(t, util_pct_window(600, 240, 15), u32(16))`; stats_test re-pins measured end-to-end values `testing.expect_value(t, p.util_pct, u32(4))` / `testing.expect_value(t, p.tx_octets, u64(962))`; CSV literal `"P,7,0,1,15,270,240,1,100,1,1,1,5,5,5,2,0,6,0\n"`; ci-local.sh:69 wires `tools/harness.sh stats-check pause && tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention`; suites green (42 core + 239 app tests). P1 gaps — repo grep `bundle_tx_record|bundle_tx_window` → only ./core/bundles.odin:184/204, ./core/stats.odin:203, ./core/flow.odin:994 (no test); bundles_test.odin grep `tx_` → empty; noc_overlay_test builds no pipe rows.
detail: P0 100% (honest-util happy path + saturation/single-stream pinned pure and end-to-end; 48/48 goldens + replay-identity green). P1 ≈43% (ring expiry, W-boundary reuse, rebuild reset, noc_pipe_rows predicate untested). Overall ≈60%.
recommended_fix: Land the tx-ring unit tests (expiry, slot reuse at 240, rebuild reset), a discriminating noc_pipe_rows row-count case, and the label-math pins — lifts P1 ≥90% and overall ≥80% to PASS.
